resultText:
Root cause: `perform()` fetched the selected elements with `includeBoundTextElement: true` and blindly took index `[0]`. `getSelectedElements` includes the bound text element in the result whenever it's encountered while iterating the scene's element array, and since only the arrow's id is in `selectedElementIds`, whichever of the two (arrow or its bound text) happens to come first in that document's element array ends up at index `0`. If the bound text element sorts before the arrow (document-dependent, e.g. due to z-order/creation order), `selectedElement` becomes the text element, whose `id` doesn't match `appState.selectedLinearElement.elementId` — tripping the invariant and crashing.

Fix: drop `includeBoundTextElement: true` from that lookup (packages/excalidraw/actions/actionLinearEditor.tsx:56-59), matching the `predicate`/`PanelComponent` in the same action, which already select only the arrow itself. This has no effect on the action's exposed conditions or on line-editing behavior — it only fixes which element is picked for the invariant checks.
